## Description

Create YAML corpus files in plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/components/ covering USWDS v3 components with guidance and token references. Update _index.yaml and docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml.

## testing_mode
GREEN

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] YAML files created in plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/components/ covering: form inputs, buttons, navigation, alerts, banners, modals, tables, typography, cards, pagination, date picker, file input
- [ ] Each file has: rule_id, prior_art (uswds.gov + uswds/uswds GitHub URL), precedence, domain:[components], component:[<uswds-component-name>], compliance:[section-508], license:CC0-1.0
- [ ] Form-related entries (form inputs, validation, date picker, file input) tagged with component:[form]
- [ ] comment at top of each file documents component: tag values per Story-6 precision query contract
- [ ] Summary + Detail tiers populated per entry; no file exceeds 500 lines
- [ ] USWDS version (v3.x) noted in source field; verify license against uswds/uswds LICENSE file (CC0-1.0)
- [ ] check-corpus-schema passes on all components/ files
- [ ] ref-query returns top result with component:[form] for query 'USWDS form validation'
- [ ] _index.yaml updated with all new entries + --validate-index passes
- [ ] docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml updated with uswds/uswds (type: github-repo, license: CC0-1.0, pinned version: v3.x)
- [ ] All tests in test_corpus_components_uswds.py pass (GREEN)

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: components/ covers 9+ USWDS v3 components, CC0-1.0, Summary+Detail
- DD2: Form entries have component:[form], documented in comment
- DD3: _index.yaml updated + --validate-index passes
- DD4: schema passes
- DD5: ref-query precision query returns correct result
